justification: Slice 1 of the brief enrichment plan: wire the already-built VG comparables and sales into a new market_context card, surface the LEP land-use permitted/prohibited lists on the planning controls card, and per-form Housing SEPP eligibility with clause citations reusing the single engine run. Verified by live A/B smoke on the four demo addresses: only the intended additions changed, no pre-existing card state moved.

pre_impl.existing_data: All three cards wire EXISTING data: services/vg_comparables.py (117 comps / 97 sales at Concord in the Slice-0 golden capture), lep_land_use_table (the same table _permitted_engine_forms reads, columns confirmed live in Slice 0), and evaluate_eligibility (already invoked for the capacity ceiling). No new analysis or source was built.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Adversarial review found arcgis_get_with_retry returns an empty dict on ANY failure, so a failed VG query was indistinguishable from zero comparables (the da_outcome silent-zero class) — fixed at source by raising when the features key is absent. Also the real Concord capture has ALL seven SEPP forms ineligible, which corrected a wrong test expectation.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: market_context is a NEW SSE section rather than a re-emit into economics because the frontend renders every section event (a re-emit would duplicate the card) and comparables need zone + lot area, which resolve after economics streams. The land-use fetch and eligibility extraction extend existing functions in intelligence_brief.py; development_permissions_db.py was checked and reads the older regulatory_provisions table, not lep_land_use_table.

functions.name: _fetch_market_context
functions.input: coordinates, zone code, lot area and the subject propid for the comparable and sales queries
functions.output: dict with comparables analysis, sales list and a per-half failure reason; raises only when both halves fail
functions.if_none: a missing zone or lot area sets the comparables reason and still fetches sales, so one resolution gap never blanks the whole card

functions.name: _build_market_context
functions.input: the raw fetch dict from _fetch_market_context or None when the whole fetch failed
functions.output: MarketContext with per-half DataFields — comparables DERIVED, sales AUTHORITATIVE, failures NOT_AVAILABLE with the reason
functions.if_none: returns None so the section renders an honest unavailable card, never a fabricated zero-comparables answer

functions.name: _fetch_land_use_lists
functions.input: zone code and the LGA name, matched via the same _norm_lga normalisation the engine uses
functions.output: permitted and prohibited development-type lists plus the matched row count, rows validated through LepLandUseRow
functions.if_none: zero matched rows means the council is not in the structured dataset — the builder renders a distinct not-extracted state, while a DB error raises and surfaces as a retryable failure

functions.name: _sepp_eligibility_results
functions.input: zone, coordinates, lot area, lot width and the heritage flag for the eligibility engine
functions.output: the per-form FormEligibility list, an empty list when no forms apply, or None when the engine errored
functions.if_none: None surfaces as a NOT_AVAILABLE eligibility field on the SEPP card, never a silent no-forms-apply

functions.name: _build_sepp_eligibility_field
functions.input: the eligibility results list or None from the single engine run
functions.output: DataField of HousingSeppFormOutput rows carrying clause citations for the card
functions.if_none: a typed-contract violation in the rows is caught and returned as NOT_AVAILABLE with a reason instead of killing the stream

values.value: lot_area_m2 and lot_width_m siblings on the sepp_housing SSE event
values.read_at: services/intelligence_brief.py sepp_housing yield, from the valuation and the cadastral lot dimensions
values.if_missing: the frontend lot-versus-minimum line degrades to showing only the standard's minimum, never a wrong comparison

queries.purpose: permitted/prohibited development types for the resolved zone, LGA-matched in Python via _norm_lga
queries.where_clause: WHERE zone = %s AND permissibility IN ('permitted', 'prohibited') — parameterised, read-only

break_it.scenario: The VG ArcGIS endpoint rate-limits or its circuit opens, so arcgis_get_with_retry returns an empty dict
break_it.what_happens: Before the fix the card would confidently render zero comparable lots nearby; now get_comparable_values raises, the half is NOT_AVAILABLE with the reason, and the card says it couldn't retrieve
break_it.how: features-key check raises in services/vg_comparables.py; test_vg_transport_failure_raises_instead_of_zero_comparables plus the genuine-empty twin test

break_it.scenario: The comparables half fails while the sales query succeeds
break_it.what_happens: The sales table still renders with its genuine data; only the comparables block shows the retry message — one VG layer down never blanks the other

break_it.scenario: Another council's land-use rows share the queried zone (Bayside rows when the lot is in Burwood)
break_it.what_happens: The permitted/prohibited development types query matches by zone across all councils by design; the _norm_lga filter excludes the foreign rows, the row count is zero and the card shows the not-extracted state — a neighbouring council's permitted uses are never presented as this lot's
break_it.how: the WHERE zone query at services/intelligence_brief.py:1840 returns all-LGA rows by design; the _norm_lga filter excludes non-matching councils, exercised with real captured Bayside rows; test_other_council_rows_do_not_leak_into_this_lga

break_it.scenario: Wingecarribee (Bowral) is not in the 25-LGA structured land-use dataset and its LEP maps no height or FSR layer for the lot
break_it.what_happens: The land-use fields render the not-extracted state distinct from a DB failure, and height/FSR render as no-control-mapped-in-this-LEP rather than a retrieval failure — confirmed on the live Bowral smoke run
break_it.how: three-state tests for the land-use field plus the UNMAPPED_LEP_CONTROLS frontend branch; live smoke output shows height None at authoritative on Bowral

break_it.what_happens: The SEPP card notes the per-form assessment couldn't run while the standards table still renders; the capacity ceiling independently retries once — never a silent no-forms-apply on either surface
break_it.how: _sepp_eligibility_results returns None which _build_sepp_eligibility_field wraps as NOT_AVAILABLE; test_eligibility_engine_error_is_not_available_never_empty

break_it.scenario: A refactor re-invokes evaluate_eligibility for the capacity ceiling
break_it.what_happens: The precomputed results from the SEPP card are passed into _lmr_uplift_form; the guard test patches the engine to explode so any second invocation fails the suite

post_merge.db_reset: none — the land-use query is read-only and parameterised
post_merge.other_repo: none — new SSE section and sibling keys pass through the Trigger.dev relay transparently (verified pattern from prior section additions); backend goes live via Railway from main on merge
post_merge.manual_verify: live A/B smoke already run on Concord, Belmore, Hurstville, Bowral: only the intended additions differ from baseline; after Railway deploys, open /reports/intelligence-brief for Concord and confirm the Market Context card and per-form SEPP citations render
